articles.title: Airbnb must face Los Angeles lawsuit alleging price gouging during 2025 wildfires
articles.description: Airbnb must face a lawsuit by the city of Los Angeles, which accused the home rental company of price gouging during ​the January 2025 wildfires in southern California, City Attorney Hydee Feldstein Soto said on Tuesday.
